↳ Posted by Theirlandais on March 14th, 2014.

Version 5 above

is a setting from the lovely playing of Aisling Hunt, a young box player from near Tulla, Co. Clare. It differs from other settings here and from Eileen’s actual rendering.

Setting number 4, from ‘Theirlandais’, is the closest to the notes Eileen O‘Brien’s plays. She did indeed compose this tune in the late 1970s and gave it the highly original title ’Eileen O‘Brien’s Reel’. 8)) It’s a fine tune.

I won’t publish the ‘corrrect’ setting here just now as I haven’t asked for her permission to do so - but it would set the record straight.

Regards
David
